title: Binary Search
description: Given a sorted integer array, return the index of target or -1 if it is absent.

title: Search Insert Position
description: Return the index of target in a sorted array, or the index where it should be inserted.

title: Find First and Last Position
description: Return the first and last index of target in a sorted array, or -1 -1 when absent.
outputFormat: Print the first and last indices.

title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array
description: Search a rotated sorted array of distinct values and return the target index or -1.

title: Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array
description: Return the minimum value in a rotated sorted array of distinct integers.

title: Find Peak Element
description: Return the index of any element strictly greater than its neighbors.

title: Search a 2D Matrix
description: Determine whether target occurs in a matrix whose flattened order is sorted.

title: Koko Eating Bananas
description: Return the minimum integer eating speed that finishes all banana piles within h hours.

examples.explanation: A speed of 4 is the smallest that finishes in 8 hours.

title: Capacity To Ship Packages Within D Days
description: Return the minimum ship capacity needed to deliver all packages in order within the given number of days.

examples.explanation: Capacity 15 completes delivery in five days.

title: Minimum Days to Make Bouquets
description: Return the minimum day needed to make m bouquets using k adjacent flowers, or -1 if impossible.

examples.explanation: By day 3, three flowers have bloomed.
